site.title: Scaling AI Systems
site.tagline: What breaks between the pilot and the ten-thousandth user.
site.audience: Engineering leaders past MVP, hitting scale problems
site.description: Case studies and cost anatomies for teams that cleared the proof-of-concept stage and are now finding out what only shows up at real scale.

articles.title: When Code Replaces Departments
articles.hook: Scaling AI isn't a model problem; it's a boundary problem. When an agent's output volume rivals a department, the wall between platform engineering and business operations collapses.

articles.title: Who Owns the Agent?
articles.hook: Scaling AI is not a compute problem; it is an orchestration boundary problem.

articles.title: Who Signed Off?
articles.hook: The audit gap isn't a compliance problem — it's an architecture problem. You cannot retroactively inspect what you didn't instrument at the point of decision.
